g.text: Subscription clarity, flow, and calm financial control
A calm subscription command center for tracking renewals, shared plans, analytics, reminders, and smart add workflows.
Warm neutrals with precise status accents.
Friendly display voice for product headings, calls to action, and memorable brand moments.
Paired with Huninn for Traditional Chinese support.
Dark command surfaces, rounded but structured cards, calendar grids, stacked subscription objects, and soft spotlight transitions.
A controlled flow system for recurring money.
Use flowing linework to suggest movement, compact dashboards to suggest control, and warm canvas blocks to keep finance from feeling cold.
Tone: clear, calm, focused, useful, quietly premium.
Flow Through Your Subscriptions with Clarity.
Logo mark: flowing S / chain path / subscription loop
